title: Oxford 3000 — A1 Beginner
description: Từ vựng nền tảng: giao tiếp hằng ngày, gia đình, đồ vật quen thuộc.

items.label: word
items.example: a man/horse/unit

items.definition: used before countable or singular nouns referring to people or things that have not already been mentioned

items.label: word
items.example: a book about flowers
items.exampleVi: một cuốn sách về hoa
items.definition: on the subject of somebody/something; in connection with somebody/something

items.label: word
items.example: The water came above our knees.

items.definition: at or to a higher place or position than something/somebody

items.label: word

items.label: word
items.example: leisure/outdoor/recreational activities
items.exampleVi: hoạt động giải trí/ngoài trời/tiêu khiển
items.definition: a thing that you do for interest or pleasure

items.label: word
items.example: Both lead actors (= the ones who play the main parts) are outstanding.
items.exampleVi: Cả hai diễn viên chính (= những người đóng vai chính) đều xuất sắc.

items.label: word

items.label: word
items.example: add something Next add the flour.

items.definition: to put something together with something else so as to increase the size, number, amount, etc.

items.label: word

items.exampleVi: Bài luận của bạn không đề cập đến những vấn đề thực sự.
items.definition: to think about a problem or a situation and decide how you are going to deal with it

items.label: word
items.example: Children must be accompanied by an adult.
items.exampleVi: Trẻ em phải có người lớn đi kèm.
items.definition: a fully grown person who is legally responsible for their actions

items.label: word
items.example: expert/practical/professional/medical advice
items.exampleVi: lời khuyên của chuyên gia/thực tế/chuyên môn/y tế
items.definition: an opinion or a suggestion about what somebody should do in a particular situation

items.label: word
items.example: Don't be afraid.
items.exampleVi: Đừng sợ.
items.definition: feeling fear; frightened because you think that you might be hurt or suffer

items.label: word
items.example: We'll leave after lunch.
items.exampleVi: Chúng tôi sẽ rời đi sau bữa trưa.
items.definition: later than something; following something in time

items.exampleVi: chiều nay/hôm qua/ngày mai
items.definition: the period of time from 12 o'clock in the middle of the day until about 6 o’clock in the evening

items.label: word
items.example: This must never happen again.
items.exampleVi: Điều này không bao giờ được xảy ra nữa.
items.definition: one more time; on another occasion

items.label: word
items.example: As he aged, his memory got worse.
items.exampleVi: Khi ông ấy già đi, trí nhớ ngày càng kém.
items.definition: to become older

items.label: word
items.example: When he said that, I had to agree.
items.exampleVi: Khi anh ấy nói vậy, tôi đành phải đồng ý.
items.definition: to have the same opinion as somebody; to say that you have the same opinion

items.label: word
items.example: Let's go out for some fresh air.
items.exampleVi: Chúng ta hãy ra ngoài hít thở không khí trong lành.
items.definition: the mixture of gases that surrounds the earth and that we breathe

items.label: word
items.example: Gatwick Airport
items.exampleVi: Sân bay Gatwick
items.definition: a place where planes land and take off and that has buildings for passengers to wait in

items.label: word
items.example: All of the food has gone.
items.exampleVi: Tất cả thức ăn đã hết rồi.
items.definition: the whole number or amount

items.label: word
items.example: She's fluent in French and German. She also speaks a little Italian.

items.definition: in addition; too

items.label: word
items.example: There's almost always somebody at home in the evenings.
items.exampleVi: Buổi tối hầu như luôn có ai đó ở nhà.
items.definition: at all times; on every occasion

items.label: word
items.example: an amazing feat/story/experience
items.exampleVi: một kỳ tích/câu chuyện/trải nghiệm đáng kinh ngạc
items.definition: very surprising, especially in a way that you like or admire

items.label: word
items.meaning: mạo từ bất định (trước nguyên âm)
items.example: She ate an apple for breakfast.
items.exampleVi: Cô ấy ăn một quả táo vào bữa sáng.

items.label: word
items.example: bread and butter
items.exampleVi: bánh mì và bơ
items.definition: also; in addition to

items.label: word
items.example: Her behaviour really made me angry.
items.exampleVi: Hành vi của cô ấy thật sự khiến tôi tức giận.
items.definition: having strong feelings about something that you dislike very much or about an unfair situation

items.label: word
items.example: the animals and birds of South America
items.exampleVi: các loài động vật và chim ở Nam Mỹ
items.definition: a creature that is not a bird, a fish, a reptile, an insect or a human

items.label: word
items.example: Would you like another drink?
items.exampleVi: Bạn có muốn uống thêm một ly nữa không?
items.definition: one more; an extra thing or person

items.label: word
items.example: I repeated the question, but she didn't answer.

items.definition: to say, write or do something as a reaction to a question or situation

items.label: word
items.example: We need some more paint; there isn't any left.
items.exampleVi: Chúng ta cần thêm sơn; không còn chút nào cả.
items.definition: used in negative sentences and in questions and after if or whether to refer to an amount or a number, however large or small

items.label: word
items.example: Is anyone there?

items.definition: used instead of someone in negative sentences and in questions after if/whether, and after verbs such as prevent, forbid, avoid, etc.

items.label: word
items.example: Would you like anything else?
items.exampleVi: Bạn có muốn gì nữa không?
items.definition: used instead of something in negative sentences and in questions; after if/whether; and after verbs such as prevent, ban, avoid, etc.

items.label: word
items.example: an apartment building
items.exampleVi: một tòa nhà chung cư
items.definition: a set of rooms for living in, usually on one floor of a building

items.label: word
items.example: Peel and core the apples.
items.exampleVi: Gọt vỏ và bỏ lõi táo.
items.definition: a round fruit with shiny red or green skin that is fairly hard and white inside

items.label: word
items.example: in April She was born in April.
items.exampleVi: vào tháng Tư — Cô ấy sinh vào tháng Tư.
items.definition: the fourth month of the year, between March and May

items.label: word
items.example: to improve access to services in rural areas
items.exampleVi: cải thiện khả năng tiếp cận các dịch vụ ở khu vực nông thôn
items.definition: part of a place, town, etc., or a region of a country or the world

items.label: word
items.example: He escaped with only a broken arm.
items.exampleVi: Anh ấy thoát được chỉ với một cánh tay bị gãy.
items.definition: either of the two long parts that stick out from the top of the body and connect the shoulders to the hands

items.label: word
items.example: The house is built around a central courtyard.
items.exampleVi: Ngôi nhà được xây quanh một sân trong ở giữa.
items.definition: surrounding somebody/something; on each side of something

items.label: word
items.example: I'll wait until they arrive.
items.exampleVi: Tôi sẽ đợi cho đến khi họ đến.
items.definition: to get to a place, especially at the end of a journey

items.label: word
items.example: modern/contemporary art
items.exampleVi: nghệ thuật hiện đại/đương đại
items.definition: the use of the imagination to express ideas or feelings, particularly in painting, drawing or sculpture

items.label: word
items.example: to read/write/publish an article
items.exampleVi: đọc/viết/xuất bản một bài báo
items.definition: a piece of writing about a particular subject in a newspaper or magazine, on a website, etc.

items.label: word
items.example: an exhibition of work by contemporary British artists
items.exampleVi: một cuộc triển lãm tác phẩm của các nghệ sĩ đương đại người Anh
items.definition: a person who creates works of art, especially paintings or drawings

items.label: word
items.example: They were all dressed as clowns.
items.exampleVi: Tất cả bọn họ đều ăn mặc như những chú hề.
items.definition: used to describe somebody/something appearing to be somebody/something else

items.label: word
items.example: How old are you—if you don’t mind me/my asking?
items.exampleVi: Bạn bao nhiêu tuổi—nếu bạn không phiền tôi hỏi?
items.definition: to say or write something in the form of a question, in order to get information

items.label: word
items.example: at the corner of the street
items.exampleVi: ở góc phố
items.definition: used to say where something/somebody is or where something happens

items.label: word
items.example: She was born in August.
items.exampleVi: Cô ấy sinh vào tháng Tám.
items.definition: the 8th month of the year, between July and September

items.label: word
items.example: Aunt Alice
items.exampleVi: Dì Alice
items.definition: the sister of your father or mother; the wife of your uncle or aunt

items.label: word

items.exampleVi: vào mùa thu năm 2024
items.definition: the season of the year between summer and winter, when leaves change colour and the weather becomes colder

items.label: word
items.example: The beach is a mile away.
items.exampleVi: Bãi biển cách đây một dặm.
items.definition: to or at a distance from somebody/something in space or time

items.label: word
items.example: The baby's crying!
items.exampleVi: Em bé đang khóc!
items.definition: a very young child or animal

items.label: word

items.exampleVi: Bố mẹ cô ấy ủng hộ lựa chọn nghề nghiệp của cô.
items.definition: to encourage somebody or give them help; to give financial support to somebody/something

items.label: word

items.exampleVi: Tôi e rằng tôi có tin xấu cho bạn.
items.definition: unpleasant; full of problems

items.definition: a container made of cloth, leather, plastic or paper, used to carry things in, especially when shopping or travelling

items.label: word

items.exampleVi: bóng gôn/quần vợt/bowling/bóng đá
items.definition: a round object used for throwing, hitting or kicking in games and sports

items.label: word
items.example: a bunch of bananas
items.exampleVi: một nải chuối
items.definition: a long curved fruit with a thick yellow skin and that is soft inside, which grows on trees in hot countries

items.label: word
items.example: a rock/punk/jazz band
items.exampleVi: ban nhạc rock/punk/jazz
items.definition: a small group of musicians who play popular music together, often with a singer or singers

items.label: word
items.example: I don't have much money in the bank at the end of the month.
items.exampleVi: Cuối tháng tôi chẳng còn nhiều tiền trong ngân hàng.
items.definition: an organization that provides various financial services, for example keeping or lending money

items.definition: to ban or prevent somebody from doing something

items.label: word
items.example: I'm in the bath!
items.exampleVi: Mình đang ở trong bồn tắm!
items.definition: a large, long container that you put water in and then get into to wash your whole body

items.label: word
items.example: Go and wash your hands in the bathroom.
items.exampleVi: Đi rửa tay trong phòng tắm đi.

items.label: word

items.exampleVi: Tôi đang học tiếng Trung.
items.definition: used with a present participle to form progressive tenses

items.label: word

items.exampleVi: trên bãi biển, khách du lịch tắm nắng trên bãi biển
items.definition: an area of sand or small stones (called shingle), next to the sea or a lake

items.label: word
items.example: a beautiful woman/girl
items.exampleVi: một người phụ nữ/cô gái xinh đẹp
items.definition: having beauty; giving pleasure to the senses or to the mind

items.exampleVi: giường đơn/giường đôi

items.definition: a room for sleeping in

items.definition: earlier than somebody/something

items.exampleVi: Cô gái đứng sau Jan là ai vậy?
items.definition: at or towards the back of somebody/something, and often hidden by it or them

items.definition: to feel certain that something is true or that somebody is telling you the truth

items.example: He dived below the surface of the water.

items.definition: the most excellent thing or person

items.label: word

items.exampleVi: một tổ chim có hai quả trứng

items.label: word

items.exampleVi: Chúc mừng sinh nhật!

items.label: word

items.definition: the very darkest colour, like night or coal

items.label: word

items.exampleVi: Cô ấy có mái tóc vàng dài.
items.definition: pale gold in colour

items.label: word

items.definition: the colour of a clear sky or the sea on a clear day

items.definition: a vehicle (smaller than a ship) that travels on water, moved by oars, sails or a motor

items.label: word

items.exampleVi: Đặt sớm để tránh thất vọng.

items.exampleVi: Tôi sinh năm 1996.

items.label: word

items.label: word

items.label: word

items.definition: the colour of earth or coffee

items.definition: a large road vehicle that carries passengers, especially one that travels along a fixed route and stops regularly to let people get on and off
